name: Tynningö, Björnholmen and Oxdjupet
description: Two-day Vaxholm-area route linking Bogesund, Tynningö, Björnholmen camp, Oxdjupet, Stegesundet and Vaxholm Fortress.

waypoints.name: Björnholmen
waypoints.notes: Bookable island/base-camp context must be distinguished from wild camping.

launchNotes: Staffed rental base with multiday gear options.

safety.exposure: Easy to moderate, with traffic exposure around Oxdjupet and Vaxholm.
navigationNotes: Use navigation map and avoid fairways where possible.

campingRules: Björnholmen is a bookable/private base camp in the source context; verify camping legality for any alternative sites.

protectionRules.summary: Central archipelago route with mostly private/settled islands; use public/legal landings only and do not assume camping access.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Avoid private docks and residential shore zones.
No route-level overnight/camping recommendation until legal landings are identified.

needsFollowup: Verify exact current protection boundaries against Naturvårdsverket Skyddad natur map before public navigation/import.
Clarify whether Björnholmen should be modeled as accommodation rather than campsite.
contradictions: Björnholmen can be misread as public camping; source describes a bookable island base camp.
caveats: Route geometries are approximate waypoint corridors, not GPX tracks and not navigational advice.
Facilities use approximate point coordinates when exact rack/harbor/building coordinates were not available in the source record.
Keep original sources and needsFollowup fields attached during import.
